subject: Financial Management and Strategic Management
paper_name: Paper-6: Financial Management and Strategic Management
question_text:
4.  
What are the Net Profit Ratio and the Return on Total Assets of Solstice Biotech Ltd. for 
FY 2025–26?  
(A)  
15.00% and 9.17% 
(B)  
18.00% and 10.00% 
(C)  
14.00% and 12.00% 
(D)  
10.50% and 9.17% 
(2 Marks)
suggested_answer: (D) Net Profit Ratio = Profit After Tax ÷ Sales × 100 = 1,680 ÷ 16,000 × 100 = 10.5% Return on Total Assets = Profit After Tax ÷ Total Assets × 100 = 1,680 ÷ 18,312 × 100 = 9.17%
